representation.plain_text: G ′ i ← reverse(G i ) Top10 forward ← StructureExpert.select_top_10(G i , D) Top10 reversed ← StructureExpert.select_top_10(G ′ i , D) T i ← intersection(Top10 forward , Top10 reversed ) if T i is empty then T i ← [Top10 forward [0], Top10 reversed [0]] end AllTop10 groups ← AllTop10 groups ∪ T i end T ← AllTop10 groups T ′ ← reverse(T ) Top10 final_forward ← StructureExpert.select_top_10(T, D) Top10 final_reversed ← StructureExpert.select_top_10(T ′ , D) T final ← intersection(Top10 final_forward , Top10 final_reversed ) if T final is empty then T final ← [Top10 final_forward [0], Top10 final_reversed [0]] end Uniport Filtering: PDB final ← Uniport_filter(T final )
